palettes.nyc42: deep charcoal brown ground with warm amber and ochre paper, small cream highlights
palettes.ldn: warm off-white ground with pillar-box red and deep charcoal paper
palettes.lnd: deep navy blue ground with pale blue and chalk white paper, one small red accent
palettes.cmx: warm cream ground with magenta and deep plum paper, small gold highlights
palettes.mxo: deep forest green ground with terracotta and warm cream paper
palettes.dst: deep slate blue ground with pale grey-blue and warm cream paper, one small brass accent
palettes.fwf: deep indigo ground with periwinkle and pale lilac paper, small cream highlights

new-york-comic-con-2026.subject: an irregular arrangement of comic book panels of markedly different sizes and tones, tilted a few degrees off square, one blank speech balloon overlapping two of them, halftone dot fields inside three panels
new-york-comic-con-2026.detail: nine or ten panels, never a tidy grid and never four equal squares — tall narrow ones beside wide short ones, each a different paper tone across amber, ochre, cream and deep brown, the whole arrangement rotated slightly so no edge is parallel to the frame. Wide gutters with hard shadow between the sheets, one panel torn along a diagonal, a starburst shape breaking out from behind the panels at the lower left rather than dominating the centre

village-halloween-parade-2026.subject: a procession of paper lantern and mask silhouettes along a diagonal, a crescent moon disc above
village-halloween-parade-2026.detail: built as a long diagonal procession of lantern and mask silhouettes climbing from the lower left to the upper right, each figure a flat sheet slightly overlapping the next, a large crescent disc high on the right, a low band of torn skyline paper along the bottom

nyc42.open-house-new-york-weekend-2026: a stack of building cross-sections cut from paper, staircases and floor plates exposed, one rooftop water tower silhouette

broadway-week-fall-2026.subject: a wide fan of overlapping ticket rectangles across the lower half, three long horizontal rows of small round bulb discs above them, tall narrow curtain strips closing both sides of the frame
broadway-week-fall-2026.detail: entirely abstract and flat — no building, no facade, no marquee board, no perspective and no floor. Every element is a separate sheet of matte paper lying almost flat against the ground with a soft shadow under its edge: the tickets are plain unmarked rectangles fanned like a dealt hand, the bulbs are evenly spaced circles in three straight rows, the curtains are simple vertical paper strips with folded edges. Nothing in the picture is a sign or a board that could carry writing

nyc42.broadway-week-harry-potter: a tall stage proscenium arch, heavy curtain folds, one narrow diagonal beam of light crossing it
nyc42.broadway-week-hadestown: a staircase descending into darkness, a single warm glowing lamp disc, smoky layered bands
nyc42.broadway-week-stranger-things: an inverted forest of bare tree silhouettes mirrored along the horizon, a thin jagged rift of light
nyc42.broadway-week-six: six tall microphone silhouettes in a row, a simple crown shape above the centre one
nyc42.broadway-week-oh-mary: a small intimate proscenium, one velvet drape swagged to the side, a single bright spotlight circle on the boards
nyc42.broadway-week-the-lion-king: a large sun disc rising over layered savannah horizon bands, a lone acacia tree silhouette
nyc42.broadway-week-wicked: a spiral of layered emerald green paper against amber, a tall pointed hat silhouette at the edge
nyc42.broadway-week-chicago: art deco fan and sunburst shapes, a bentwood chair silhouette, stacked jazz-age chevrons

london-design-festival-2026.subject: a modular grid of abstract furniture and object silhouettes, some cells empty, precise alignment
london-design-festival-2026.detail: built as a precise modular grid of nine cells, each holding one abstract object silhouette in a different paper weight, three cells deliberately empty, hairline gutters between them and a single cell lifted off the ground with a hard shadow beneath it

ldn.open-house-festival-2026: layered terraced building facades in receding planes, one door standing open with light behind it
ldn.totally-thames-2026: a wide river ribbon curving through the frame, two bridge arch spans crossing it, small boat shapes

lord-mayors-show-2026.subject: a ceremonial coach wheel and ornate carriage lantern shapes, layered bunting pennants above
lord-mayors-show-2026.detail: built around one large ornate coach wheel dominating the right half in cut paper spokes, a carriage lantern shape to its left, three tiers of layered bunting pennants strung across the upper third, deep shadow separating each tier

notting-hill-carnival-2026.subject: tall paper feather plumes and layered ribbon streamers rising in a diagonal sweep, scattered confetti squares
notting-hill-carnival-2026.detail: built as a broad diagonal sweep of tall feather plumes and ribbon streamers rising from the lower left, each plume a stack of three paper tones, a scatter of small square confetti across the upper right, the ground kept almost empty

giant-summer-flea-olympic-park.subject: a row of striped market stall awnings, stacked crates and hanging bunting triangles
giant-summer-flea-olympic-park.detail: built as a row of five striped stall awnings in receding perspective, scalloped edges, stacked crates in the foreground shadow, a string of bunting triangles crossing above them, one awning catching light

lnd.the-big-brine-hackney-bridge: rows of paper preserving jars with domed lids on a shelf, cut lemon and cucumber discs beside them

gran-premio-ciudad-de-mexico-2026.subject: a racing circuit ribbon looping through the frame, chequered pattern fading at one edge, speed chevrons
gran-premio-ciudad-de-mexico-2026.detail: built as one wide circuit ribbon looping through the frame in a flat figure of eight, the ribbon cut from three tones of paper so its banking reads as depth, a chequered pattern dissolving into separate squares at the right edge, speed chevrons stacked along the lower left

gran-desfile-dia-de-muertos-2026.subject: layered papel picado banners with cut geometric patterns, marigold flower discs massed below
gran-desfile-dia-de-muertos-2026.detail: built as four tiers of papel picado banners strung across the upper two thirds, each tier a different cut pattern and paper tone with shadow falling on the tier behind, a dense massed field of marigold discs filling the lower third

cmx.del-color-de-la-sandia-cenart: geometric watermelon slice wedges arranged as a fan, seeds as small dots, bold flat shapes

fil-guadalajara-2026.subject: open books cut from flat paper, pages fanned into a wide arch spanning the frame, a bright doorway shape beneath the arch
fil-guadalajara-2026.detail: built as open books cut from flat paper and stacked into a wide architectural arch spanning the frame, pages fanning outward as separate overlapping sheets, a tall bright doorway shape beneath the arch, the stacks receding in three depths

filij-2026.subject: paper boats and kites folded from book pages rising on a diagonal, playful scattered confetti squares
filij-2026.detail: built as folded paper boats and kites rising on a strong diagonal from the lower left to the upper right, each one a separate sheet with a visible fold line and cast shadow, trailing kite strings as thin cut strips, scattered confetti squares in the upper corner

dubai-tokenised-property-secondary-marke.subject: a building elevation cut into a grid of small equal tiles, a few tiles lifted away and floating free of the facade, a flat exchange arrow loop below
dubai-tokenised-property-secondary-marke.detail: built as three planes — the tiled elevation flat against the ground, a dozen tiles suspended above it at varying heights with hard shadows cast back onto the wall, and a low band of paper beneath holding two interlocking arrows; the lifted tiles read as pieces of one whole, not as debris

dst.gitex-moves-to-expo-city-2026: a large exhibition hall shape with a domed roof on the right, an older rectangular hall on the left, a broad arrow of layered paper crossing between them

rta-starts-commercial-robotaxi-operation.subject: a car silhouette in flat paper seen from above, a sensor dome on its roof, concentric scanning arcs radiating outward across a grid of streets
rta-starts-commercial-robotaxi-operation.detail: built as a plan view: a street grid of thin cut strips as the ground, one car shape centred on it, four or five concentric arcs spreading from its roof in decreasing paper tones, the empty driver's seat implied by leaving the cabin an open cut rather than a filled shape

fwf.dubai-second-in-bcg-intelligent-cities-i: a podium of three stacked paper blocks with the second one tallest in tone, a ring of small city tower silhouettes around them
fwf.vara-rules-for-virtual-asset-derivatives: two paper contract sheets overlapping at an angle, a stepped line chart cut from paper rising across them, a small padlock shape at the corner
fwf.dubai-land-department-tokenisation-pilot: a flat paper tower block whose right edge breaks apart into a drifting field of small hexagon tiles, a single key shape lying across the lower corner, no sheet or document shape anywhere

broadway-week-which-shows-are-worth-it.subject: rows of small paper theatre seats seen from directly above, arranged in clear pairs, one seat of every pair in a bright saturated tone and the other pale, a heavy curtain strip closing the top edge
broadway-week-which-shows-are-worth-it.detail: the pairing is the whole picture: eight rows of seats recede up the frame, and in every row the seats are unmistakably grouped two by two, the left of each pair bright and the right pale, so the doubling reads instantly from a thumbnail; the seats are simple rounded paper cushions with a soft drop shadow, the aisle a clean channel of ground colour up the middle, and a single band of curtain closes the top; no tickets, no signs, no rectangles with borders, no flat panels of any kind

nyc42.brooklyn-museum-fall-2026: six framed panel shapes hung in two rows on a gallery wall, each a different paper tone, one panel a tall vertical scroll, a bench silhouette below
nyc42.hudson-river-foliage-cruises: a wide river band curving between two layered hill masses in autumn tones, a small boat shape on the water leaving a paper wake
nyc42.disney-cruises-return-to-nyc: a tall white multi-deck cruise liner in flat paper seen from the side, rows of small round portholes along the hull, two rounded funnels, calm harbour water below and a low city skyline behind

ten-exhibitions-on-in-london.subject: ten empty picture frames of different proportions hung across a gallery wall in an irregular salon arrangement
ten-exhibitions-on-in-london.detail: built as a salon hang: ten frames of markedly different sizes and orientations, each cut from a different paper tone and mount depth so the wall reads as layered rather than flat, hung tight with uneven gaps, three of them slightly overlapping; the frames stay empty, the composition is the subject

ldn.va-exhibitions-closing-dates: a row of gallery doorways in receding depth, the nearest one with its shutter half lowered, a small clock disc above
ldn.notting-hill-carnival-turns-60: a rectangular commemorative plaque shape mounted on a brick wall of cut paper courses, a spray of small feather and ribbon shapes fanning from behind it
ldn.partial-lunar-eclipse-over-london: a large pale cream disc with a dark navy disc overlapping its upper right so a clean curved bite is cut out of it, a low band of layered rooftop shapes beneath, deep night ground

sl12-superloop-gants-hill-rainham.subject: a long looping bus route line in flat paper crossing the frame, eleven stop discs threaded along it, a double-deck bus silhouette at one end
sl12-superloop-gants-hill-rainham.detail: built as one continuous cut ribbon making a wide loop from the lower left to the upper right, laid over a faint grid of streets, with evenly spaced stop discs punched along it and a flat double-deck bus silhouette sitting on the ribbon near its start; the loop is the composition and reaches all four edges

lnd.bank-holiday-tube-and-tfl-closures: three parallel route lines in flat paper, two of them broken by cut gaps, a barrier shape standing across one gap
lnd.olympic-park-summer-school: a cluster of workshop table shapes seen from above in a park, a stadium arc curving behind them, small tool and instrument silhouettes scattered on the tables

juegos-mundiales-robots-humanoides-2026.subject: a running track lane band sweeping across the frame, a stylised robot figure cut from flat paper mid-stride on it, a stopwatch disc above
juegos-mundiales-robots-humanoides-2026.detail: built as a sprint: three lane bands running left to right in graded paper tones, the robot a jointed flat-paper figure of simple geometric segments leaning forward at speed with a hard shadow under it, motion lines as three thin cut strips trailing behind, a plain stopwatch disc with no numerals in the upper right

museo-del-gato-reforma.subject: a cat silhouette curled in a sunlit window opening cut into a facade of flat paper, a row of smaller window openings beside it
museo-del-gato-reforma.detail: built as a facade seen straight on: a wall of cut paper with five window openings in a row, four of them empty and dark, the second one lit warm with a single flat cat silhouette curled on its sill; the lit window is the focal point and everything else stays quiet

cmx.s301-la-estrella-mas-rapida: a small bright star shape trailing a long curved path of graded dots that sweeps close past a large black circle set low in one corner, deep night ground, no concentric rings
cmx.casa-del-lago-unam-sustentable: a pavilion roof shape with rain falling as thin vertical paper strips, a cistern tank shape below collecting them, layered tree canopies behind
cmx.metrobus-cierres-por-mantenimiento: a thick transit line of flat paper running corner to corner with fifteen station discs along it, three sections of the line lifted clean away leaving gaps, striped barrier shapes and traffic cones standing in the gaps
cmx.fin-de-semana-del-31-de-octubre: the frame split down the middle by a vertical cut, marigold flower discs massed on the left half, a chequered racing band sweeping across the right
cmx.plaza-de-la-conchita-jardin-polinizador: a paved plaza shape seen from above with an irregular green area cut into it, flower discs scattered across the green, small bee and butterfly shapes above
cmx.semovi-nuevo-contrato-ecobici: a row of bicycle silhouettes in a docking rank, receding in flat paper layers, a small satellite marker pin above one of them
cmx.betsabee-romero-homenaje-a-monsivais: a wall of small framed objects — magnifying lens discs, a wrestling mask shape, a boxy television silhouette — arranged in an irregular grid

moderna-vacuna-melanoma-fase-3.subject: a syringe silhouette in flat paper laid diagonally, a stepped bar chart rising beside it, a shield shape behind them
moderna-vacuna-melanoma-fase-3.detail: built in three layers: a broad shield outline as the ground plane, a clean stepped bar chart of five ascending bars cut from graded paper in front of it, and one long syringe silhouette laid across the whole thing on a diagonal with a hard shadow; clinical and calm, no drama, no red

telescopio-roman-lanzamiento.subject: a space telescope silhouette in flat paper against a dark field, a very wide cone of view opening from its aperture, a scatter of small star discs across the cone
telescopio-roman-lanzamiento.detail: built to show the width of the field: the telescope is small and sits low at the left, and the cone opening from it spreads across the whole frame in three graded paper tones, filled with star discs of four different sizes; the emptiness outside the cone is as much of the composition as the cone itself

mxo.record-temperatura-oceano-2026: a wide ocean of layered paper waves in graded tones, cool blue at the far horizon warming to hot orange in the foreground, a single thin ribbon lifting away from the water surface
mxo.capuchinos-cazan-cuando-falta-fruta: a layered forest canopy in flat paper with a monkey silhouette on a branch, a few fruit discs on one side and none on the other
mxo.hirosaki-mil-ochocientas-personas-castil: a tiered castle keep silhouette in flat paper resting on a track of rollers, a long thick rope cut from paper running from it to the frame edge
mxo.cova-de-les-dones-inscripciones-romanas: a cave mouth opening cut into layered rock strata, a narrow passage receding into darkness, faint tally marks scored on the rock faces
mxo.cuatro-cienegas-borrego-cimarron: a bighorn sheep silhouette standing on a layered desert ridge, a bison silhouette smaller and further back, pools of water cut as flat discs below
mxo.tren-ligero-texcoco-la-paz: a straight light rail line in flat paper crossing the frame with eleven station discs along it, a tram silhouette at one end, a lake shape behind
mxo.filij-2026-regresa-al-cenart: a small open book shape opening into a paper tent, a scatter of folded paper animals around it
mxo.kusama-320-mil-visitantes: a dense field of flat paper discs of many sizes covering the whole frame, a mirrored room opening cut into the middle of them
mxo.john-giorno-en-kurimanzutto: a gallery wall of flat paper with a rotary telephone handset shape mounted on it, a stack of vinyl record discs below, a long paper strip unrolling down the wall
